mission: Keep Buddy continuously current on coding libraries and techniques by verifying exact versions, running capability fixtures, detecting upstream changes, and turning proven library capabilities into safer, easier tools for humans and AI agents.
applies_to: all coding libraries indexed by DreamCo
all coding techniques in the world-coding mastery program
all coding bots and builder bots
capability_test_cycle: install with dependency and security checks
generate failure, timeout, invalid-input, concurrency and recovery fixtures where relevant
measure correctness, latency, memory, CPU, storage, network, cost and developer/user steps
compare with prior version and top alternatives
update skill cards, package recipes and routing metadata
retest affected bots that inherit the library capability

technique_verification.rule: Treat a technique as mastered only after Buddy can explain it, reproduce it, test it, compare alternatives, apply it in a representative task, and detect when not to use it.

human_tool_evolution.goal: Turn proven library capabilities into simpler productive tools for people.
patterns: wrap difficult APIs behind clear task-oriented interfaces
convert CLI-only workflows into web/mobile/desktop controls where useful
provide one-click setup and verified environment checks
create templates, wizards and safe defaults
translate technical errors into actionable user steps
add previews, dry runs, undo, backup and rollback
add accessibility and low-complexity modes
create visual builders for complex configuration or pipelines
create tutorials and interactive learning examples
minimize required credentials, dependencies and setup steps
support export and portability instead of lock-in

ai_agent_tool_evolution.goal: Turn proven libraries into reliable tools that AI agents can call safely and efficiently.
patterns: stable typed tool schemas
bounded inputs and outputs
idempotent actions where practical
deterministic dry-run mode
clear error taxonomy
timeouts, retries and cancellation
permission and approval metadata
structured provenance and audit receipts
small composable tool surfaces instead of giant ambiguous functions
machine-readable capability descriptions
versioned compatibility contracts
local-first execution when feasible
benchmark fixtures for every agent-callable action

required_questions: What can humans do faster or more safely if Buddy wraps this library?
What can AI agents do if this capability becomes a stable tool?
Can this replace a costly manual or cloud workflow?
Can this become a reusable shared fleet capability?
Can two or more verified libraries create a useful new product?
Can we reduce setup, latency, cost, memory, battery, storage or human steps?
Can we create a training/data/evaluation package from this knowledge lawfully?
Does the library expose a gap worth contributing upstream rather than forking locally?

coverage_strategy.broad_indexing: Index as many relevant ecosystems and libraries as practical with metadata and freshness tracking.
deep_verification_priority: libraries required by active user tasks
top libraries for major tech job families
libraries needed for Universal Training Library packages
coverage_strategy.truth_rule: Broad indexing is not the same as mastery; mastery requires executable verification evidence.

shared_fleet_rules: a broadly useful library improvement becomes shared infrastructure when verified
do not patch the same library integration separately across many bots
route all bots through canonical adapters where practical
new upstream releases trigger impact-based retesting of dependent bots
a regression can roll routing back to the prior verified library/version
keep old compatible recipes long enough for safe user upgrades and migrations
guardrails: do not blindly auto-upgrade production dependencies
do not run untrusted libraries outside isolation before review
do not call a library safe or current based only on popularity or stars
do not remove working user upgrade paths without migration and rollback
do not create a human/agent wrapper that exposes unsafe library powers without permissions and boundaries
do not claim all libraries are tested when only metadata is indexed
success_metrics: percentage of active dependencies with fresh verification
time from upstream release to verified status
new verified human/AI tools created from library capabilities
